title: Full-suite evacuation test fails at base: the child test binary's registry-guard root is left in childTmp by the SIGTERM exit
body: go test ./internal/cli/ -run 'TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote' (no -short) fails at the base commit 4aa2400c80fd with "the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<n>]". The child is this test binary re-exec'd with TMPDIR=childTmp, so its TestMain's registrytest.GuardMain setup() creates its private temp root ticfac-registry-guard-* inside childTmp; the SIGTERM handler's os.Exit skips GuardMain's RemoveAll, and the parent's ticfacTemp leftover assertion then counts the guard's own root as a run temp tree. The per-tick gate never sees it because the test skips under -short.
